name: Towanda
seo_title: Towanda Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Towanda, Kansas for 2026: 4 family events at Fulton Valley Farms, with dates, times and prices checked on the host's site.
lede: Towanda does Christmas on one big farm: Fulton Valley Farms lights its wooded paths with more than 2 million lights, and adds Santa, live reindeer, a live Nativity and family meals, about 25 minutes from Wichita.
celebrates: Towanda's Christmas season centers on Fulton Valley Farms at 5079 SW Fulton Road, which the farm says is about 25 minutes from Wichita. A Country Christmas runs on 17 select nights from November 27 to December 30, with more than 2 million lights set to music, a Santa Station, Santa's live reindeer, the Jingle Bell Emporium gift shop and a Live Nativity called A Journey to Bethlehem at 7:30 pm every open night. Families can add Supper with Santa, a Christmas Dinner or Pancakes with Santa, and the farm lists Barrel Train Ride and Santa Shuttle Sleigh Ride extras.
lastyear: A Country Christmas ran last season from November 28 to December 28, 2025, according to the farm's 2025 ticket page, which promised more than 1.7 million lights, Santa, live reindeer and a live Nativity at the Towanda farm. KWCH news also covered the family-run tradition ahead of the 2025 season, describing the light display as synchronized to music. This year the farm lists more than 2 million lights and opens for the first time after Christmas, on December 26 through 30.
facts: Fulton Valley Farms says 2026 brings several firsts: it is open after Christmas for the first time ever, from December 26 to 30, and Pancakes with Santa adds a Christmas Eve morning session. The farm also lists The Tipsy Elf, a new adults-only drink tent, and a 28-foot decorated tree in the Boot Scootin' Barn. Santa visits the Santa Station on open nights before Christmas, and after December 25 he has gone back to the North Pole.
trains: We did not find a train ride in Towanda itself apart from the Barrel Train Ride, a $3 extra at Fulton Valley Farms. In Wichita, the Great Plains Transportation Museum shows Santa Fe 4-8-4 No. 3768 and is open Saturdays, 9 am to 4 pm, according to our museum page. Watson's Christmas Express in Wichita runs Fridays through Sundays from November 28 to December 20, according to the city. See our Wichita page for both, and our Kansas train rides guide for more.
train_links: A railroad museum in Newton, Kansas.

kidfact: Kids 3 and under do not need a ticket at Fulton Valley Farms, and Santa's reindeer are live animals you can pet.
faq: Fulton Valley Farms hosts A Country Christmas on 17 select nights, with more than 2 million lights, Santa, live reindeer and a live Nativity at 7:30 pm. The farm adds Supper with Santa, a Christmas Dinner and Pancakes with Santa.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Towanda for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, none marked free. The magic runs from November 27 (A Country Christmas and Supper with Santa at Fulton Valley Farms) through December 30 (the last night of A Country Christmas), with Pancakes with Santa (December 5, 12 and 19), Christmas Dinner (December 11, 18 and 23) and the Christmas Eve Pancakes session along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Towanda

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Towanda
  • Free events: none, every Fulton Valley Farms event is ticketed, and kids 3 and under are free
  • Meet Santa: Supper with Santa (November 27 and December 4), Pancakes with Santa and the Santa Station at A Country Christmas
  • Parades and tree lightings: none found in town
  • Trains: the Barrel Train Ride at Fulton Valley Farms; the Great Plains Transportation Museum and Watson's Christmas Express are in Wichita
  • Season: November 27 to December 30
